title: Convoy: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Convoy loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Choose a destination, stage fuel or food, identify a fallback shelter, and mark the route before loading valuable cargo.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A first convoy route should have a start point, destination, emergency return point, cargo purpose, and a reason to stop before trouble compounds.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Convoy is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
